en: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder.

zh: 大衛的紀念詩，交與伶長。

ja: 指揮者のために。ダビデの詩。記念として。

p.src: 1  Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.

en: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.
u.src: 1  Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.

p.src: 2  Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

ja: じ入りますように。 私の破滅を望む
たちが、不名誉のうちに引き返しますように。
en: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
u.src: 2  Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

p.src: 3  Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

ja: を受けて引き返しますように。
en: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”
u.src: 3  Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

p.src: 4  Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

ja: しみますように。 あなたの
いますように。 「神が高く上げられますように。」
en: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”
u.src: 4  Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

p.src: 5  But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.

ja: てください。 あなたは私の
en: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.
u.src: 5  But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.
